clinical_alignment_notes: Framingham and SCORE2 were evaluated only on held-out rows with the variables those scores require.
This is still a directional benchmark because the local target is a risk-level label rather than adjudicated 10-year clinical events.
Framingham was run with the lipid-based general CVD equation and assumes untreated systolic blood pressure because treatment status is unavailable.
SCORE2 was run with the published low-risk-region recalibration and should be interpreted cautiously because the dataset is not a European cohort.

framingham_comparison.eligibility: Held-out rows aged 30-74 with sex, cholesterol, HDL, systolic BP, smoking, and diabetes.

score2_comparison.eligibility: Held-out rows aged 40-69 with sex, cholesterol, HDL, systolic BP, smoking, and diabetes.
